recognize_zh: 藍色復染（methylene blue）背景中，只有中間兩條細長、略彎的洋紅色桿菌，這是抗酸染色（acid-fast stain）陽性的分枝桿菌（mycobacteria）；菌量稀少，需在高倍下仔細搜尋。
features: Acid-fast stain with blue methylene blue counterstain
Rare slender, slightly curved magenta-red bacilli in the center of the field
Bacilli lie among plump epithelioid-type histiocyte nuclei
Paucibacillary: only two organisms visible in this high-power field
No background necrosis or other organisms identifiable at this resolution
describe_en: Acid-fast (Ziehl-Neelsen-type) stained tissue section shows a cellular background of oval histiocyte nuclei with pale cytoplasm in blue counterstain. Rare slender, slightly curved magenta acid-fast bacilli are identified near the center of the field. Organisms are sparse. Findings are consistent with mycobacterial infection; culture or PCR is needed for speciation.

ddx.vs: Nocardia forms branching beaded filaments that are only weakly (modified) acid-fast, whereas mycobacteria are short, non-branching, strongly acid-fast rods.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterium avium complex in immunosuppressed host
ddx.vs: MAC typically shows sheets of histiocytes stuffed with innumerable bacilli, while M. tuberculosis granulomas are usually paucibacillary as here; speciation requires culture or PCR.
True bacilli have uniform slender rod shape with parallel sides and occasional beading, whereas precipitate is irregular, refractile and often out of the plane of focus.
